conclusion: The next executable source artifact should implement bounded ASC mailbox-word transactions and RTKit management negotiation against a deterministic fake mailbox. The reference grounds those messages; it does not grant this XNU guest exclusive GPU ownership, establish the loaded T8103 firmware ABI, or justify adopting firmware TTBR1. GPU publication remains blocked.

ownership_and_lifecycle.established: HV init defaults arm-io MMIO to hardware passthrough, sets HCR.TTLBOS, maps guest RAM and excludes MCC carveouts. These operations describe accessibility and CPU virtualization, not exclusive GPU ownership or a GPU reset/handoff.
ownership_and_lifecycle.required: Before any transport binding, identify one owner of gfx-asc mailbox/IRQ, SGX registers, power/clock domain, firmware shared areas and all UAT contexts; exclude concurrent proxy experiments, guest drivers and inherited pending traffic. Existing RAM identity mappings do not prove that every descriptor PA is a usable GPU address.

ownership_and_lifecycle.established: AGX construction reads ADT regions, disables proxy framebuffer use and pokes SGX. AGX.resume calls ASC.start and starts endpoints0x20/0x21; ASC.start sets CPU RUN and sends IOP_INIT, then waits for power acknowledgements. AGX.start allocates channels/initdata, sends initdata and device-control messages. recover writes firmware halted/resume fields. None is a passive observer or ownership acquisition.
ownership_and_lifecycle.required: Do not equate resume, CPU RUN or power ACK with acquiring an idle device or completing all DMA. Startup/recovery must be selected from a positively identified inherited state. No such state is established by this report.

ownership_and_lifecycle.established: AGXTracer.resume re-enables tracing; it is distinct from AGX.resume and does not constitute GPU or firmware ownership.
ownership_and_lifecycle.required: Do not treat tracer start/resume or cached initdata as a driver handoff.

established: 64 context slots; two root words per slot at gpu-region-base + 16*context. Context0 is used for firmware/kernel mappings.

bind_context rejects context0 but otherwise takes a caller-selected context and uses that number as ASID for both root words. It contains no exclusive allocation, collision detection, generation or release protocol.

The reference allocates TTBR0 but deliberately reuses firmware TTBR1 at gfx-shared-region-base. init clears part of that inherited table, performs global outer-shareable invalidation and publishes roots under the handoff lock.
required: A later driver may reserve a software slot in1..63 only after device ownership is externally established; a software bitmap or unused-looking root is not proof no firmware/user owns it. Context0 must remain unavailable to ordinary user contexts.

Frozen private001 forbids imported firmware/user tables. Keep that boundary: reconstruct a new owned TTBR1 from an independently identified firmware mapping contract, or design a separate explicit firmware-region capability with provenance and lifecycle. Do not silently adopt the reference TTBR1.

No slot reuse or table reclamation after possible publication until jobs, firmware references, translation invalidations and data-cache work are all proven complete. No such real completion path exists here.

coherency_invalidation_completion.evidence: proxyclient/m1n1/hw/uat.py:487-507; proxyclient/m1n1/fw/agx/handoff.py:7-20,34-128; proxyclient/m1n1/agx/object.py:239-261; proxyclient/m1n1/agx/channels.py:133-149; src/proxy.c:689-690; src/hv/hv_exc.c:208-211,271-281; src/hv/hv_sprr.c:655-711
established: flush_dirty writes dirty table bytes and issues TLBI ASIDE1OS with context shifted48. The nearby dc_civac operation is commented out; invalidate_cache only clears Python page-table cache.

Handoff lock explicitly depends on barriers implicit in proxy operations. The C proxy command dispatcher ends with DSB SY and ISB. This does not provide an equivalent barrier contract for new in-guest shared-memory stores.

HV passes/replays outer-shareable TLBIs; in emulated SPRR it also drops CPU shadow-ASID state. That is evidence of source routing, not a proof of GPU completion or a private GPU ASID namespace distinct from CPU ASIDs.

The reference private-buffer cleanup sequence remaps Shared, invalidates, writes a handoff flush request, sends FWCtl, waits for state change, unmaps/invalidates and clears state2. Handoff state arrays cover0..0x40; 0x40 is used as a flush context and is not a65th normal UAT context.
Python handoff and several waits are unbounded; comments explicitly question parts of unmap ordering. A queue done pointer or event notification is not a blanket memory-quiescence proof.
coherency_invalidation_completion.required: Before publication, establish XNU CPU mapping/cache attributes for each allocation, visibility to GPU/ASC, the exact stores/barriers/TLBI acknowledgement ordering under this HV mode, handoff structure ABI, bounded firmware completion matching, and allocation lifetime after failure. Never substitute IOMD complete or a host counter for these hardware facts.

established: Conventional ASC mailbox carries two64-bit words; the endpoint is in low8 bits of the second word. The reference register aperture/order is source evidence only; no address mapping is selected here.
MIT C RTKit supports protocol versions11..12 and negotiates intersection. Python chooses firmware maximum with a FIXME, so use the bounded C version contract rather than that permissive policy.

Management HELLO type1/ACK2, EPMAP8, IOP power6/ACK7 and AP power0xb use type bits59:52. Startup is CPU start, IOP_INIT0x220, negotiated HELLO, endpoint map acknowledgements, required system endpoints, IOP_ON0x20, AP_ON0x20 and its acknowledgement.

AGX firmware endpoint0x20 and doorbell endpoint0x21 are separate from management0. AGX initdata message type0x81 carries44-bit address data; runtime use also needs owned UAT mappings and the exact initdata layout.
AGX ioalloc maps host allocations through UAT context0. Firmware system-endpoint buffers therefore require real address/lifetime handling, not just management wire parsing.
T8103 initdata source uses a40-bit physical mask, three UAT levels and host_mapped_fw_allocations=1. Layouts vary with firmware-version selectors.

The inspected firmware image identification table has T6030/T8122 entries, not T8103. Python set_version uses u.version and SoC generation. Neither establishes the actual loaded T8103 GPU image ABI in this session.
required: Positively identify the inherited T8103 firmware image/version and ABI without assuming the boot-loader version is sufficient; define allowed preloaded firmware segments and ownership before sending any initdata.

Management power-ready is not GPU-ready. Required crash/syslog/ioreport/oslog endpoint buffers need bounded owned mappings and explicit teardown contracts. Unknown endpoints or allocation requests must remain blocked, never acknowledged with dummy addresses.
The C inherited-ASC helpers inspected alongside this path describe DCP-specific inheritance; they cannot be applied as a GPU handoff contract.

next_executable_source_artifact.deliverable: Original portable C mailbox transaction/control engine plus host transcript executable and pinned ARM64 compile. Its first complete transaction is RTKit version negotiation and bounded endpoint discovery; the terminal result is CONTROL_DISCOVERED_PROTOCOL_ONLY, never firmware/GPU ready.
scope: No active MMIO backend, IOKit service/start method, kext, CPU RUN operation, GPU initdata, UAT publication, IRQ handler or firmware upload. Inputs are captured/synthetic 64-bit mailbox words and explicit monotonic time; outputs are bounded pending management-message actions.

One context and one pending send transaction. A generation identifies the pending action; commit it once only after the transport reports the full word pair accepted. Backpressure preserves identical pending bytes. Partial/uncertain send produces sticky failure and no replay.

Validate HELLO version intersection11..12, message/endpoint fields and state transitions. Track at most eight32-bit endpoint-map chunks and256 endpoint bits; duplicates/conflicts, missing final map, unsupported versions, stale completions, unexpected power ACK and malformed input refuse. Numeric queue/deadline limits are new conservative policy, not inferred firmware timing.

Use a nonzero monotonic deadline and total message/step budget; refuse clock rollback/overflow and timeout. No infinite polling. Require advertised AGX0x20/0x21 before CONTROL_DISCOVERED_PROTOCOL_ONLY.

Return the advertised system-endpoint requirements explicitly. Do not start them or advance to power-ready until a future reviewed owned-buffer provider exists. Known bitmaps are not permission to access GPU or firmware memory.
next_executable_source_artifact.why_this_slice: It replaces an actual missing driver control transaction with executable byte-accurate state transitions, delivery ownership and failure handling, while avoiding ungrounded firmware initdata and inherited-page-table assumptions. It can later be connected to a separately admitted ASC transport without changing the protocol core.
acceptance_tests: Golden literal HELLO/EPMAP replies checked against both pinned MIT definitions; full synthetic management-discovery exchange, bounded queued output and exact final endpoint bitmap.
Out-of-order/duplicate/conflicting messages, unsupported versions, absent GPU endpoints, all endpoint-map base boundaries, send backpressure, failed/partial send and repeated-completion fault cases.

Timeout/clock rollover/zero clock, state/token mutation tests, sanitizer runs, NDEBUG and ARM64 object/import audit. Tests must show that discovery success emits no initdata, doorbell or firmware-buffer address.
next_executable_source_artifact.later_hardware_binding_gate: Requires explicit release of GPU observer hold plus separate source-bound candidate and real sole-owner/inherited-state evidence. Protocol tests or a software ownership flag cannot satisfy that gate.
